name: Hazardous chemicals and dangerous goods
what: Register to import or make industrial chemicals, and meet state rules for storing, handling and transporting hazardous chemicals and dangerous goods, including licences for some quantities.

basis.source: Retail and wholesale trade industry (industry information)
basis.quote: If you import industrial chemicals, you must register your business with the Australian Industrial Chemicals Introduction Scheme (AICIS) .

basis.quote: handling, storage and use of chemicals or dangerous substances

issues.what: Making or importing chemicals involves several regulators at every tier, with complaints of duplication and delay.

evidence.source: Annual Review of Regulatory Burdens on Business: Manufacturing and Distributive Trades
evidence.quote: Chemicals and plastics manufacturing - and importing - in Australia is subject to a wide range of regulations, administered by several agencies at all levels of government.

evidence.source: Annual Review of Regulatory Burdens on Business: Manufacturing and Distributive Trades
evidence.quote: Several submissions to the Regulation Taskforce raised issues with chemicals and plastics regulation, relating to duplication, delays and lack of consistency with international standards.
